sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Qwen3 introduces several key advancements to enhance its functionality and usability. First, it integrates two distinct operating modes, thinking mode and non-thinking mode, into a single model. This allows users to switch between these modes without alternating between different models, e.g., switching from Qwen2.5 to QwQ (Qwen Team 2024).

sources.title: Qwen3 4B Base by Qwen (Alibaba) — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact base model that punches above its weight for its parameter count, showing solid multilingual text understanding and generation across Chinese and English. As a base model, it has no instruction-following tuning, so it completes text rather than answering questions — it needs fine-tuning or prompting scaffolding to behave like an assistant.
